messages:
Alex: Escalating — acme-inc reports a streaming call that ends with a client broken pipe and our pipeline marked it as a 5xx. Customer says tokens were billed and they want a refund if it was their client dropping. Trace: tr-9b3f. Repro steps they sent below.

Alex: ```bash
curl -v -N -H 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d @prompt.txt 
# client writes a few chunks then client process exits (EPIPE)
```

Sam: Can you paste the gateway trace logs (ingress id) and the exact metering event id?

Alex: Gateway logs (trimmed):
```
2026-04-12T15:12:34.123Z ingress-gw[gw-5] trace=tr-9b3f req_id=abc123 method=POST path=/v1/stream proto=HTTP/1.1 te=chunked client_ip=35.9.1.2
client_state=halfclose upstream_status=200 bytes_sent=1240 conn_event=FIN
meter_event=ERR_PROXY_EOF classification=5xx
```
Customer-side snippet (node): `write EPIPE` then process exits.

ops-bot: Noted: ingress-gw pool scaled +2 at 2026-04-12T15:11:50Z. Attached ingress node: gw-5.

Maria: If upstream returned 200 but our metering pipeline flagged ERR_PROXY_EOF as 5xx that's likely our EOF classification. Which rule fired?

Zach: I dug into the runtime heuristic — we currently mark connections as 5xx when the gateway sees a premature FIN/RST before the chunked `0\r\n\r\n` trailer is observed and we haven't forwarded a terminal chunk. That can incorrectly flag client-initiated halfclose as gateway error if the client closes between chunks.

Zach: Quick repro I ran: `python -c "import socket; s=socket.create_connection(('api.redwood.ai',443)); s.send(b'POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: api.redwood.ai\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n5\\r\\nhello\\r\\n') ; s.close()` -> gateway shows ERR_PROXY_EOF and meter rules increment 5xx.

Luis: Customer uses older `node-fetch` and an internal extension that doesn't send final chunk on abrupt shutdown. Client logs show `EPIPE` at the write. So I think it's a client abort.

Sam: Actionable: (1) Add temporal exception: if upstream 200 and conn_event in {FIN, CLOSE} and bytes_sent > 0, classify as `client_abort` not 5xx for billing. (2) Capture pcap / full proxy span for tr-9b3f and run RPC replay to confirm.

Alex: I'll collect pcap + proxy span from gw-5 for time window 15:11:30-15:12:40 and attach. cc @Maria for billing hold :thumbsup:

Maria: Ack. If logs show client-side `EPIPE` and upstream 200, we'll issue a retro-metering adjustment and credit. Paste the meter_event id once you have it.

Sam: Temporary mitigation: pushed small rule to staging to ignore ERR_PROXY_EOF as billable when upstream_status==200. We'll promote after validation.

Alex: Thanks. I'll update thread with trace artifacts.

Luis: Also recommend we add a note in SDK docs about sending final chunk or `Connection: close` semantics to reduce ambiguous closes.

Maria: Pls ensure we record decision in billing change log before issuing credits.

Alex: Will do — collecting artifacts now (tr-9b3f).
